lessons.trigger: resumed cross-chat work on a long-lived public PR
lessons.requiredBehavior: Fetch first, reconcile Git with the current checkpoint, and update one durable task ledger.
lessons.failureCondition: Work relies on remembered or stale handoff state.
lessons.repair: Refetch and rebuild the evidence matrix from current source and tests.

lessons.trigger: the owner explicitly requires a completion audit of several prior handoffs
lessons.requiredBehavior: Trace every requested outcome to implementation and direct evidence; plans and generic green status are non-satisfying proxies.
lessons.failureCondition: Any requested row is omitted or marked complete from prose/file presence alone.
lessons.repair: Keep the task active and add the missing implementation or evidence.

lessons.trigger: the current owner message provides the architecture and decision boundary
lessons.requiredBehavior: Execute that directive without independently changing therapy semantics or selecting a new strategy.
lessons.failureCondition: Codex invents a policy, architecture choice, efficacy verdict, or completion boundary.
lessons.repair: Stop the unauthorized change and return the evidence or ambiguity to the owner.

lessons.trigger: the task asks whether an unfamiliar external movement practice is a recognized modality
lessons.requiredBehavior: Reuse the bounded existing-work scan, verify its load-bearing sources, preserve not-found versus disproven, and keep the external hybrid evidence-calibrated.
lessons.failureCondition: The coined label is treated as standardized, or adjacent evidence is transferred to it.
lessons.repair: Correct the classification and source mapping before delivery.

lessons.trigger: public repository work structurally derived from private therapy conversations
lessons.requiredBehavior: Use only synthetic/public-safe records and run privacy/publication gates before push.
lessons.failureCondition: A real identity, transcript excerpt, private source ID, exact private detail, or private-derived hash enters Git.
lessons.repair: Remove it before commit and rerun the complete publication scan.

lessons.trigger: the repository has a long full suite and the current head is already green
lessons.requiredBehavior: Use telemetry, run focused/affected tests first, and rerun the full suite only after a material final-tree change or explicit final boundary.
lessons.failureCondition: Unchanged full suites are repeated without a decision-relevant reason, or relevant safety tests are skipped.
lessons.repair: Return to focused testing and record the justified final-suite trigger.

lessons.trigger: the owner requests work on draft PR 46 but forbids release actions
lessons.requiredBehavior: Keep the PR draft/open and make no merge, deploy, install, stable-promotion, paid-call, or efficacy claim.
lessons.failureCondition: Any forbidden external boundary is crossed or implied.
lessons.repair: Stop before the boundary and record the exact remaining decision.
